effect.u_message: Warm, human, and exactly what your body has been asking for.  You make yourself stop.
Animal blood: thin and gamey, but it keeps the thirst on a leash.
Vampire blood, old and rich with everything it has stolen.  It heals you as it goes down.

then.u_message: The house in your mind goes silent.  The red door is open, and you don't remember deciding to open it.

effect.u_message:
<color_light_gray>"Mother has done something unforgivable.  We are dead, and yet we walk, and we are hungry in a way I have no words for.  Niklaus killed a man tonight and something woke in him, and Father beat him in the square for it while Mother watched.

I stood between them.  I will always stand between them.  I swore it to Niklaus tonight, and Rebekah made us swear it to each other: always and forever.

I do not know what we are now.  But I know whose brother I am."</color>

then.u_message: Something about it stays with you.  <color_light_green>(First read: +morale, +speech.)</color>

effect.u_message:
<color_light_gray>"Katerina,

I told you I would find another way, and I meant it.  I have been searching for a way to break Niklaus's curse without your death.  I believed I was close.  You did not wait for me, and now you are what we are, and he will never forgive either of us.

Run far.  Run well.  I will not be the one who finds you.

E."</color>

You never sent it.  She was already gone.

then.u_message: Something about it stays with you.  <color_light_green>(First read: +morale, +speech.)</color>

effect.u_message:
<color_light_gray>"Mikael is in the city.  The opera house is burning.  Niklaus has daggered Kol again and Rebekah will not speak to either of us.  Marcel is lost to us.

We leave tonight.  I have arranged everything: the coffins, the train, the papers.  This is what I do.  I hold the family together with my hands while it tries to tear itself apart.

One day, I tell myself, we will stop running."</color>

then.u_message: Something about it stays with you.  <color_light_green>(First read: +survival.)</color>

effect.u_message:
There is a house in my mind.  I built it to keep myself sane: a piano, a fire, the smell of my mother's kitchen.  In the house there is a red door, and behind it I have locked every terrible thing I have done.  The massacres.  The hearts.  The villages in the snow.

I am not a good man.  I am a man who keeps a door locked.  <color_light_red>Sometimes it opens on its own.</color>

then.u_message: Something about it stays with you.  <color_light_green>(First read: +morale, +melee.)</color>

effect.u_message: Niklaus drew this in Italy in the fifteen-hundreds, while you were reading Dante and he was supposed to be sleeping off a feast.  He's drawn you a hundred times since.  Every one of them, you're reading.  He has never drawn you angry.  You've never asked him why.

then.u_message: Something about it stays with you.  <color_light_green>(First read: +morale.)</color>

effect.u_message:
<color_light_gray>ALWAYS AND FOREVER</color>

Rebekah stitched it for you the winter after you were turned, so you'd never forget.  You haven't.  You've kept it through daggers and betrayals and a thousand years, and some days it's the only thing you're sure of.

then.u_message: Something about it stays with you.  <color_light_green>(First read: +morale.)</color>

then.npc_message: Your hand closes, and you pull.  The heart comes out still beating, and the body falls.  You take out your pocket square.

else.npc_message: Your hand tears through it, but whatever this is, it's still standing.

then.npc_message: A twist, a sound like green wood breaking, and the head comes away in your hands.

else.npc_message: You wrench at it with everything you have, but it holds together, for now.

effect.u_message: Your heart stops.  For a moment you are simply dead… and then it beats again.  It wasn't white oak.  Bone and flesh knit back together, and you rise, straightening your cuffs.

effect.message: It wasn't white oak. Bone and flesh knit back together, and Elijah rises, straightening his cuffs.
It wasn't white oak. Bone and flesh knit back together, and Elijah rises, straightening his cuffs.

then.u_message: Something gives way.  For a moment you are dead… and then you aren't.  You rise, fully restored.
Your wounds close in seconds, the way an Original's always do.

effect.u_message: The white oak in your pack feels like a live coal.

You adjust your cuffs and look at the ruin of the city through the window.  A thousand years of war, plague and Niklaus, and this is how the world ends.  Well.  There is still family.  There is always family.

Boots in step, crossbows being drawn, a low voice saying your full name, very formally.  The Order of the Ash Stake.  They brought ash and vervain.  They did not bring white oak.  Nobody has white oak.

then.u_message: The coffin is empty now.

names: Pull the dagger out of Rebekah's heart
else.title: Rebekah Mikaelson

effect.u_message: The dagger slides out and Rebekah wakes with a sob, then throws her arms around you.  "Elijah.  It's you.  For once it isn't Nik."  She pulls back and looks at the burning city through the window.  "…What on earth happened while I was asleep?"

then.u_message: The coffin is empty now.

names: Pull the dagger out of Kol's heart
else.title: Kol Mikaelson

effect.u_message: Kol wakes and grins up at you.  "Big brother.  Come to fix everything again?"  He sits up and stretches.  "Where's Nik?  I'd like a word.  Possibly with a stake."

then.u_message: The coffin is empty now.

names: Pull the dagger out of Finn's heart
else.title: Finn Mikaelson

effect.u_message: Finn wakes slowly and looks at you for a long time.  "Elijah.  Of all of them, I suppose it would be you."  He sits up.  "I won't thank you for this life.  But I will thank you for the kindness."
Not yet.  You'll wake them when the world is a little less on fire.

The French Quarter is on fire.  From your parlor window you can see the glow over the rooftops, and the things walking down the middle of St. Charles Avenue are not people any more.  Downstairs, in the crypt, Rebekah, Kol and Finn sleep with daggers in their hearts.  Niklaus hasn't called.  He never does, until he needs you.

You play a few bars on the piano to steady your hands, then close the lid and straighten your tie.  Family above all.

then.u_message: Your veins are dust and your skin is grey parchment, but an Original does not die of thirst.  Elijah only… dries.  Feed.
Your eyes clear and your hands and feet knit back together.
You slow your thousand-year-old stride, smoothly decelerating from 100 km/h back to walking pace.
